question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product in relation to renewable materials?
data_point: mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product
description: The mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product refers to the proportion of renewable materials present in the total mass of the product. This measurement is crucial for assessing the sustainability and environmental impact of the product, as it indicates the extent to which renewable resources are utilized in its production.
